title: NHC Foods expands portfolio with Sachmaas acquisition; Q2 net up 16 times
description:
NHC Foods Ltd, an exporter of agricultural commodities and spices, reported a sharp improvement in financial performance for the September quarter, with total income rising 333 per cent year-on-year to Rs 451.32 crore and profit surging more than 16-fold to Rs 21.68 crore.
The company had reported total income of Rs 104.09 crore and profit of Rs 1.34 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, according to a company statement.
For the first half of FY27, NHC Foods posted total income of Rs 821.45 crore, an increase of 282 per cent from Rs 214.68 crore a year earlier. Profit rose nearly 13-fold to Rs 38.68 crore, compared with Rs 3.01 crore in the year-ago period.
